text:
[issue by Mo9713]
![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/8034839f-0825-46dd-9298-74049fc816cb)

I know this was mentioned in issue #344 but just wanted to point out that Curios 5.12.1 causes a crash when used with the Reforged (formerly Tiered) mod, while Curios 5.12.0 does not. Even though the root cause may be on Reforged’s side, I figured it would be useful to report that this only happens with the latest Curios version, possibly due to the tooltip changes.

Crash log: https://mclo.gs/I2ncSlx

[comment by TheIllusiveC4 (owner)]
Yes, there were some minor tooltip changes between this and the last version. Reforged will need to update their mixin accordingly to address the crash.
